attchmntText: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "DCIL Delivers Remarkable Strong Q2 Profitability Turnaround; EBITDA Rises 58.58% Year-on-Year".
voiceSummary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited filed a press release regarding its financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a Profit After Tax of 7.31 crore, compared to a loss of 34.17 crore in the previous year. EBITDA rose 58.58% year-on-year to 41.69 crore. Income from own-dredger operations increased 23.08% to 198.66 crore. Total revenue for the quarter was 211.83 crore. For the half-year ended 30 September 2026, PAT improved to 18.54 crore from a loss of 57.51 crore. The Board approved revised estimated useful lives and residual values for eligible dredgers with effect from 4 August 2026. This resulted in reduced depreciation and finance costs for the period. The announcement was submitted to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India on 10 November 2026.

attchmntText: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  M/s. Grandhy & Co. as Statutory Auditor of the company for the FY 2026-27.
voiceSummary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has appointed M/s Grandhy & Co as its Statutory Auditor for the financial year 2026-27. The Office of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India appointed the firm via letter dated 08.09.2026, and the appointment was accepted on 12.09.2026. The Board of Directors approved this appointment during its 375th meeting held on 10.11.2026. The company is intimating the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The Board meeting commenced at 15:30 Hrs on 10.11.2026. No directors have any relationship with the statutory auditor or its partners.

attchmntText: Dredging Corporation of India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter / period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dredging Corporation of India Limited approved standalone un-audited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The Board met on 10 November 2026. Profit before tax was 750.73 lakhs. Net profit was 730.94 lakhs. Earnings per share were 2.61 rupees. Revenue from operations was 21,127.65 lakhs. The statutory auditors, M/s Grandhy & Co, issued an unqualified opinion. The company also approved the appointment of M/s Grandhy & Co as statutory auditors for the financial year 2026-27. The appointment was accepted by the firm on 12 September 2026. The Comptroller and Auditor General of India appointed the auditors under section 139 of the Companies Act 2013. Results were published in Financial Express and Jansatta.
